svg.font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: The first command buffer after 5 s idle
svg.desc: From Metal System Trace: the driver's Wire Memory events for the process and the GPU's command buffers, in milliseconds from when the first command buffer of a 500-token request was encoded after 5 seconds idle. Without a keep-alive, the driver wires about 10 GB in 364 events and the GPU starts its first buffer about 66 ms later. With KeepAwake there is no wiring and the GPU starts almost at once.
svg.text: The first command buffer after 5 s idle
Metal System Trace: the dashed line is the CPU encoding the request's first command buffer
362 Wire Memory events, 10,213 MiB; the GPU starts 67.1 ms after the commit
75 Wire Memory events, 7 MiB; the GPU starts 0.3 ms after the commit
